verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a Case Management workspace for reviewing alerts, investigating, and resolving cases (sardine-docs-26). For sanctions screening, it describes AI agents routing higher-risk matches to analyst review and escalating real exposure (sardine-docs-18, sardine-docs-21), which gives some evidence of review and escalation routing. Nothing shows an operations lead assigning cases to specific analysts or configuring multi-stage review and escalation workflows, and the routing claims come from marketing pages scoped to sanctions screening. Missing for 10: explicit case assignment to analysts or queues, configurable review/escalation stages, workflow documentation beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
